headline: OH NO! — every Lemmings death now wails
lede: The never-dry rung fired on the weakest title on the shelf and shipped its most famous missing flourish: LEMMINGS-LITE answers every corpse with the original's signature two-syllable scream, plus a hand-drawn OH NO! bitmap popping on the body.

notes.text: LEMMINGS-LITE #3844 shipped (e140435): a shared sawtooth OH-NO! wail fires once per death batch — fall, drown and bomb deaths, which never even had a sting, are all answered now — under the existing per-cause sounds.

The sprite pops at the corpse and rides the world clock, so fast-forward animates it with the sim; cap 4 keeps a chain massacre from flooding the board. Death events gained x,y and lemcheck pins all three causes — the section went red exactly as designed when the stamp was stripped.

Ladder was honestly dry before the never-dry pick: next-item was a waiting-jon question, both feedback items are waiting-jon, QA held BLOB BATTLE, and all six flagship READMEs are gap-free — Lemmings scored weakest at 7 unowned gaps. The two oldest gaps (BUILDER, blocker-wake) need solver re-sizing; the next cheapest is the attract parachute demo.

look.text: Sacrifice one lemming at THE SPIRE's pond and watch it drown-scream
